notes.subject: כידוֹד
notes.rationale: 'Duɲɛ min ka bugɔrɔ' — o daɲɛ ye Tanaki kɔnɔ daɲɛ ye min tɛ o ye (kuma kɔrɔ ye ka bugɔrɔ duɲɛ ye).

notes.subject: ואגמן
notes.rationale: אגמן bɛ se ka kɛ kokoro (lasara kokoro, JPS) walima kabelu (kokoro-kabelu); JPS ka kuma tilennen 'lasara kokorow minnu bɛ tasuma' ye an ka sugandili ye.

notes.subject: kumasen in
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV ye o yɔrɔ bila Yawe ka kuma ye ('M' tɛ a dogo'); Hebrew sɛbɛnni-fɔcogo kɔnɔ, o ye Leviatan ka siyɛn-fɔli ye (JPS, Geneva).

translation: A ninyɛrɛnw kɔnɔ, siyɛn bɛ bɔ, i n'a fɔ duɲɛ min ka bugɔrɔ, ni lasara kokorow.
